concerns.text: Task T006b implements `code/downloaders.py::fetch_oqmd` using `datasets.load_dataset(..., streaming=True)`. FR-001 explicitly requires downloading via the OQMD REST API, not via Hugging Face streaming. This weakens the functional requirement by changing the data source.

Task T006e implements `code/downloaders.py::fetch_aflow` using `datasets.load_dataset(..., streaming=True)`. FR-001 mandates REST‑API based download; using a different ingestion mechanism violates the spec.
Task T006d streams MP data via `datasets.load_dataset` rather than the Materials Project REST API as required by FR-001. This constitutes a weakening of the mandated data acquisition method.

SC-003 (mean rank‑shift of the top‑10 features) is an explicit success criterion, but no task computes or records this metric. The task list only generates the rank‑shift CSV without a subsequent aggregation step, leaving the acceptance criterion uncovered.
